name: Archive
description: Archive a note you're done with but want to keep (⌘⇧E, :archive, or the tab's menu): it stays where it is and still linked, leaves the Feed, and comes last in search. Archived notes say so at the top, and the Archive view lists them. Archiving is a change to .common-ink/archive.json, so undo takes it back.

files:write.why: Archive and unarchive notes, as changes by you

editor.why: Say at the top of an archived note that it's archived
